missing_lines: All 82 lines contain inline maths or belong to display equations (1)-(5), now written in LaTeX; the native lines are glyph fragments such as 'Jα(ν) + αd(ν) + Φα(δ),', 'XNT −1', 'bℓj'. Every one of these lines was read on 250-dpi crops of the left column (y 50-740) and right column (y 48-740): the prose words around the maths match the page and approach.tex/background_v2.tex, and a word-level script check (prose words of each missing line searched in the markdown with maths removed) flagged only formula glyphs ('RNa', 'xNT', 'poj', 'arg mink', '0.05' inside $\delta=0.05$). The LaTeX was compiled with pdflatex and the rendering compared with the page.

All numbers in prose and formulas (0.05, 95%, [16], [47]-[52], equation tags (1)-(5), 1/2, 2L) were compared with the page image.
